title.narrative: Contribution to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) 2020-2025

description.narrative: The Danish contribution to IUCN's monitored on the basis of IUCN's own performance reporting. The latest report can be found at the following link: https://www.iucn.org/about/programme-work-and-reporting/annual-reports

The Danish engagement with IUCN has the overarching purpose of supporting IUCN’s Programme 2021-25 in realising its call to action by all IUCN’s Members, scientific network and Secretariat to mobilise collectively on delivering a clear and demonstrable contribution to the SDGs, the post-2020 global biodiversity framework and the Paris Agreement in developing countries.
Following this purpose, the objective of the development cooperation is support to IUCN’s global thematic and regional programmes to achieve their intended results for people, land, water, oceans, and climate, especially on climate adaptation, improved access to water resources, gender equality, and rights and inclusion of indigenous peoples.
The support consists of DKK 100 million in five tranches.
